title: Facebook, troppa visibilità a estremisti e complottisti: ecco come impatta Meta sulle elezioni
snippet: Media coverage of Fabio Giglietto's analysis of over 2.5 million Facebook posts. The piece focuses on how Meta's algorithms meant to reduce political content actually backfired, limiting official political speech while allowing conspiracy-theorist and extremist accounts to dominate user feeds.
description: An article covering Professor Fabio Giglietto's research analyzing over 2.5 million Facebook posts, focusing on how political extremist pages bypassed Meta's filters to gain visibility during elections.

title: Secondo uno studio dell'università di Urbino l'algoritmo di Facebook ora punisce la politica ufficiale e premia gli estremisti antieuropei. Pd e FdI verso una legge bipartisan sulle piattaforme
snippet: This Italian news article covers Fabio Giglietto's study on Meta's algorithmic shifts [2.2.2]. The coverage details how traditional politicians lost up to 43% of their reach on Facebook, whereas extremist, anti-EU, and conspiracy-theorist pages bypassed the filters and gained visibility, sparking political discussions about platform regulation in the Italian Parliament.
description: An Italian news article reporting on Fabio Giglietto's study from the University of Urbino, which reveals how Facebook's algorithm penalizes traditional political figures while boosting extremist and anti-EU pages.
